description: CodeHive Community Duel Night ️ Coding doesn't have to be a solo activity. Join us for the CodeHive Community Duel Night — a free online event where developers come together to challenge each other in real-time 1v1 coding duels. Pick your language, face off against another coder, and solve problems under pressure. Whether you're looking to sharpen your problem-solving skills, test yourself against other developers, or simply experience a different way to practise coding, this is your chance to get involved. What to expect: ️ Live 1v1 coding duels — challenge another developer and solve coding problems head-to-head. Real-time coding — compete directly on CodeHive. Meet fellow developers — connect with people who enjoy coding and problem-solving. Completely free — no entry fee, no paid registration. Who can participate? Students, aspiring developers, and anyone who enjoys solving coding problems are welcome. Bring your competitive spirit and a willingness to learn. How to participate: Register for the event on Unstop. Create your account on CodeHive. Complete a test duel before the event so you're familiar with the platform. Watch your email for the confirmed date, time, and joining instructions. Date and time: To be announced based on participant availability. Ready to take your coding practice beyond solving problems alone? Join us and experience coding as a multiplayer activity. See you on CodeHive!

Coding doesn't have to be a solo activity.

Join us for the CodeHive Community Duel Night — a free online event where developers come together to challenge each other in real-time 1v1 coding duels.

Pick your language, face off against another coder, and solve problems under pressure. Whether you're looking to sharpen your problem-solving skills, test yourself against other developers, or simply experience a different way to practise coding, this is your chance to get involved.

What to expect:

  • ️ Live 1v1 coding duels — challenge another developer and solve coding problems head-to-head.

  • Real-time coding — compete directly on CodeHive.

  • Meet fellow developers — connect with people who enjoy coding and problem-solving.

  • Completely free — no entry fee, no paid registration.

Who can participate?

Students, aspiring developers, and anyone who enjoys solving coding problems are welcome. Bring your competitive spirit and a willingness to learn.

How to participate:

  • Register for the event on Unstop.
  • Create your account on CodeHive.
  • Complete a test duel before the event so you're familiar with the platform.
  • Watch your email for the confirmed date, time, and joining instructions.

Date and time: To be announced based on participant availability.

Ready to take your coding practice beyond solving problems alone? Join us and experience coding as a multiplayer activity.

See you on CodeHive!
